name: Country Annual Leave Band
description: Annual leave entitlement bands by length of service. One row per step-up.

fields.label: From Service (Months)
fields.description: The band applies once the employee has completed this many months of service. 0 = from joining; 60 = after 5 years.

fields.label: Leave Days / Year
fields.description: Annual leave entitlement. The monthly accrual is this divided by 12 (30 -> 2.5, 21 -> 1.75).

fields.label: Leave-Salary Days / Year
fields.description: Days of leave salary earned per year. Equal to leave days unless the country or the company says otherwise.
